I searched for toddler basket weaving in Halton Hills this fall, then for the Town of Halton Hills' toddler art and craft programs.

- **Basket weaving:** Every basketry class that came up was an adult or older-youth workshop outside Ontario. One example is a US willow class listed for 
ages 16+, with 12-16 year olds welcome with an adult
. None were in Halton Hills or for toddlers. None of the pages mentioned underwater weaving at all.
- **Town of Halton Hills:** The town's youth and camp pages cover older ages. Its art camp is 
Tiny Tyke Art, for campers ages 4–6
, and it runs in summer, which is the wrong season and age band. Its Helson Gallery workshops are 
ages 7-12 and 13+
.
- **Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre:** Its own recreational page lists a 
Parent and Tot program for 18 months to 3.11 years
, and a fall 2026 schedule is posted. It is a real toddler class, but it is gymnastics, so I left it out.

If the parent is open to something close, a toddler parent-and-tot swim class or that gymnastics class are the nearest real options. I haven't read the swim schedules, so I can't vouch for any day, time or price.
